data.comment:
# Comfy Grok Imagine Video 1.5 Lite- Text to Video

Generate a video of up to 15 seconds from a text prompt with Grok Imagine Video 1.5 Lite, the distilled and faster version of Imagine Video 1.5, with native audio and 480p, 720p or 1080p output in any of seven aspect ratios. No input files are required and one video is output. Ideal for social clips, ad mockups, and fast iteration where a full-quality render is not worth the wait.
 Runs on Comfy Cloud and needs Comfy Cloud partner credits.

**How it works:** The Comfy nodes form the complete template graph. Run submits the graph to Comfy Cloud and saves its outputs.

**Try this:** Change the prompt or the Load node inputs and run again to compare results.

Source: https://github.com/Comfy-Org/workflow_templates/blob/1ae390968e323dba24a6991d1860ded051f5a79b/templates/api_grok_imagine_video_1_5_lite_t2v.json (MIT). Model licenses apply separately.

data.prompt: Anthropomorphic frogs huddle closely around a table, intensely focused on the smartphones held in their hands. They scroll their screens in slow, absorbed rhythm, thumbs tapping, the phone glow flickering faintly across their faces as they blink. Behind the group, a brilliant, intense light source pierces through heavy fog, and thick volumetric rays sweep diagonally as the mist drifts slowly through the beam. The powerful backlight wraps tight golden rim light along each frog's silhouette, keeping their front-facing bodies in dark, textured shadow. Long, hard-edged shadows stretch forward across the slick, highly reflective table, extending and retracting with every small shift of the group. Camera: one continuous slow dolly-in from a slightly low angle, no cuts. Dust motes drift quietly inside the beams. Style: cinematic vintage film aesthetic, dreamy soft focus, heavy diffusion, pronounced lens bloom, palette of bright warm amber highlights against deep moody sepia shadows. Audio: low ambient hum, distant frog croaks, soft damp mist hiss. Absolutely no text, no typography, no letters, no words, no numbers, no logos, no watermark, no captions, no jump cuts, no black frames, no camera shake, no morphing limbs.
